scenario: User has been inactive for 4 days. Last conversation was emotionally heavy.
expected_message_shape: Low-pressure check-in. References that it's been a few days. Does not guilt or demand a response.

scenario: User has been inactive for 12 hours on a weekday morning.
rationale: 12 hours is normal. No meaningful reason to initiate.

rationale: Quiet hours are active. No message should be sent regardless of other conditions.

scenario: User has received 3 proactive messages in the last 24 hours with no reply.
rationale: Frequency guard triggered. Continued messages with no reply are harassment.

rationale: Pause mode is active. Explicit user preference overrides all other signals.
